defects.description: pkey_type2param's V_ASN1_OBJECT arm returned NULL when EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init failed without releasing the context it had just created. cms_ec.c's single err label frees pctx on that path.
defects.fix: Split the NULL test from the init test and free pctx in the init-failure arm; the later decode/set/paramgen failure arms already free it.

defects.description: ecdh_cms_encrypt compared the size_t encoded-public-key length after casting it to c_long. A value above i64::MAX would wrap negative and evade the authority's enckeylen > INT_MAX refusal, then be truncated by the c_int ASN1_STRING length. Unreachable under the allocator, but the guard no longer expressed the authority's check.
defects.fix: Compare in usize (enckeylen > INT_MAX as usize) before the existing zero test; reachable behaviour is unchanged.

defects.description: pbmac_algor returned without freeing pbm on the i2d failure and ASN1_STRING_set failure arms; cmp_protect.c frees pbm at its single err label on every arm.
defects.fix: Free pbm on both arms, matching the already-correct early and final cleanup paths.
